Name: Hats on Animals
Author: Poplinp
Description:
[size=3]Display your extensive collection of hats while making your farm animals incredibly fashionable. Ever wanted to give that duck who finally gave you a feather to complete the community center a crown for their efforts? Today is your day. You're welcome.

Supports all vanilla coop & barn animals!
[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/wNY7X2DC/starsies.png[/img][b][color=#f4cccc][size=4]  To Use In-Game[/size][/color][/b]
[b][color=#f4cccc]
To place a hat[/color][/b], hold a hat and right-click the animal (or try to pet the animal).

[b][color=#f4cccc]To remove a hat[/color][/b], either:[list]
[*]click on the animal to open the animal query menu. If an animal is currently wearing a hat, there should appear a button to remove it (see images).
[*]Place a different hat on the animal, and the old hat should drop.
[*]Sell the animal, and the hat should drop.
[/list]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/wNY7X2DC/starsies.png[/img]  [color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][b][color=#f4cccc]New modded hats[/color][/b]: compatible, as long as they work like vanilla hats (i.e. not Fashion Sense). If you can place them on your pet, you should be able them on your farm animals.
[*][b][color=#f4cccc]New modded animals[/color][/b]: Hat placement will not work. To be clear, you SHOULD still be able to use this mod with new animals installed, you just won't be able to place hats on non-vanilla ones.
[*][b][color=#f4cccc]Vanilla animal re-textures[/color][/b]: not recommended. The exact placement of the hat is sprite-specific, so the hats would potentially be a bit off. Re-textures that keep the shape of the animal should still be good (color changes etc).
[*][b][color=#f4cccc](potentially) Truly incompatible[/color][/b]: mods that change the animal query menu (the menu that opens when right-clicking an animal), mods that change animal behavior entirely.
[/list]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/wNY7X2DC/starsies.png[/img]  [b][color=#f4cccc][size=4]Notes
[/size]
Removing the mod:[/color][/b] make sure you remove any hats you placed, otherwise you'll lose them.

I am willing to add support for SVE animals if it people want it.

Currently there's an issue with hats sometimes being slightly off when you pet the animal. It goes back to normal once the animal moves again.
I'm still working on solving this, and it is not very noticeable, but know that I am aware :)
